Samira (CEO): Opening a short thread for the security/privacy follow-ups from today's all-hands. Please drop items for leadership or docs pointers here.
Daphne (Head of Security): Thanks — will track. If you need customer-facing language, tag @Priya.
Priya (Solutions): Customer asked: will Hosted support BYOK/KMS? Timeline?
Daphne (Head of Security): Plan: Hosted BYOK via KMS integrations (AWS KMS + GCP KMS) targeted for mid-Q4. Azure KV follows after. Private already supports customer KMS/HSM.
Owen (NetEng): Networking Q: are we standardizing on PrivateLink or VPC peering for direct connectivity?
Daphne (Head of Security): Recommendation: PrivateLink first for Hosted/Dedicated because it reduces cross-account routing complexity. We'll publish a migration guide.
Priya (Solutions): Any specifics customers need to open on their firewall?
Owen (NetEng): Minimal outbound rules: 443 to control plane endpoints, DNS UDP 53. We'll produce CIDR/hostname lists by region.
Nora (Compliance): SOC2 status: readiness gaps are mapped, Type II audit planned for hosted in Q3. We'll publish the auditor and timeline once contracts close.
Samira (CEO): Will Dedicated or Private be included?
Daphne (Head of Security): Hosted in first audit. Dedicated gets attestation support and docs; Private is out-of-scope for hosted SOC because it's customer-managed infra.
Priya (Solutions): Audit logs: default retention and export options?
Daphne (Head of Security): Default control-plane retention 90d. Enterprise/Dedicated can opt into 365d add-on. We're shipping log export hooks (S3/BigQuery) next quarter.
Priya (Solutions): Great — can we get a one-pager for customers comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private security controls?
Daphne (Head of Security): Yes. Action: Daphne + Nora + Priya will draft a "Security at Redwood" FAQ for the Console and a customer one-pager. ETA: next Tuesday.
Owen (NetEng): Dev note for engs: sample egress rules and PrivateLink config will be added to repo (infra/networking).
infra-bot: Draft published: /docs/security/security-faq-draft.md (internal). Link: https://intranet.redwood/docs/security/security-faq-draft (reaction: :eyes:)
Samira (CEO): Two asks from me: 1) publish SOC2 roadmap + named auditor when ready; 2) ensure Console has a short security FAQ for customer sign-up flows. Daphne + Priya to lead.
Daphne (Head of Security): Acknowledged. We'll also add a short blurb on KMS options and how to request BYOK early for large customers.
Nora (Compliance): FYI — ISO 27001 scoping conversations have started; timeline TBD.
Priya (Solutions): I'll compile the customer questions I got from the demo and DM them to Daphne.
Samira (CEO): Thanks — please ping this channel once the one-pager and SOC2 roadmap are live.
Daphne (Head of Security): Will do. If anyone needs a briefing for customers, book time with the security team. :lock:
